subject: general
question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 3.
solution:
The correct answer is '**unhygienic**'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Based on the content of the given passage, the most appropriate title could be "Poor Hygiene at Local Food Outlets and its Effects on Health".
 
• The passage describes the poor hygienic conditions prevalent in many local dhabas and fast food joints, and how this can lead to health problems due to the use of low-quality packaging material, improper storage conditions, and inadequate cleaning of food.
 
• The passage also mentions the high content of trans fats in the food, which can lead to negative effects on health. 
 
• The most appropriate option to fill in blank number 3 would be "**unhygienic**" because the passage is describing poor hygienic conditions at local dhabas and fast food joints, and "**unhygienic**" fits this description.
 
• Let's look at the meaning of other words:
 
 
• **sterile** - free from bacteria and microorganisms
 
• **neat** - clean and orderly
 
• **energetic** - having or showing energy and enthusiasm 
 
 
 
• Thus, the correct answer is **Option 2.**

 

**Correct Passage:__** *At most of the local dhabas and fast food joints, poor hygienic conditions prevail. The contamination occurs due to poor quality packaging material or **unhygienic** storage conditions. Food cooked may not be washed or cleaned properly. It is low in (4) ________, rich in oil content especially trans fats which make one (5) ______, lousy and dull.*
